name: omnisales-data-science-sales-dashboard
description: Enterprise Multi-Brand & Multi-Product Sales Intelligence and Machine Learning Dashboard

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "cyan,emerald" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm install --prefix frontend && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.vercel-build: npm install --prefix frontend && npm --prefix frontend run build
